lead.headline: Government drafts law to bring back Gram Sarkar village councils
lead.summary: A 17-member council in each of 41,112 wards, led by the elected UP member. Experts want a pilot first.

alsoToday.headline: Cyber law draft softened, but the 10-year rumour penalty stays
alsoToday.summary: New safeguards cover journalists and media owners. NGOs and citizens get none.

special.label: Special report · Workforce
special.headline: After the USAID cuts, where did 50,000 development workers go?
special.summary: No official count, no support scheme. Our analysis traces what happened to the people who lost their jobs after the aid cuts.

Of workers in informal jobs, about 58 million people

pinnedSpecials.label: Special report · Funding Intelligence
pinnedSpecials.headline: Record pledges, shrinking NGOs: who gets Bangladesh's aid money
pinnedSpecials.summary: Foreign grants to NGOs are at a seven-year high, yet about 2,200 small NGOs face cuts. Our analysis of six years of data shows the money is reaching fewer, larger organisations.
